New message in #sales:

sarah: @lobu what's our pipeline total this month?

input.text: Hi Sarah 👋 — I'm a coding assistant, not connected to your live sales data, so I can't pull pipeline totals. You'll want to check the pipeline view in the CRM dashboard or ask whoever owns your reporting. If the pipeline view itself is broken or missing data, I can help look into the code — just let me know!
